scripts.dev:api: PYTHONPATH=. uv run --project services/api uvicorn services.api.app.main:create_app --factory --reload --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000
scripts.dev:api:local: PYTHONPATH=. uv run --project services/api --extra dev python services/api/scripts/run_local.py
scripts.db:migrate: PYTHONPATH=. uv run --project services/api python services/api/scripts/migrate.py
scripts.db:provision-room: PYTHONPATH=. uv run --project services/api python services/api/scripts/provision_room.py
scripts.db:close-room: PYTHONPATH=. uv run --project services/api python services/api/scripts/close_room.py
scripts.db:cleanup: PYTHONPATH=. uv run --project services/api python services/api/scripts/cleanup_rooms.py
scripts.generate:contracts: PYTHONPATH=. uv run --project services/api python services/api/scripts/export_contract_schema.py && npm run generate:types
scripts.generate:types: json2ts -i contracts/schema.json -o apps/web/src/generated/contracts.ts --bannerComment "/* Generated from contracts/schema.json. Do not edit by hand. */"
scripts.check:contracts: PYTHONPATH=. uv run --project services/api python services/api/scripts/export_contract_schema.py --check && node scripts/check-generated-contracts.mjs
scripts.test:api: PYTHONPATH=. uv run --project services/api --extra dev pytest services/api/tests
scripts.lint:api: uv run --project services/api --extra dev ruff check services/api/app services/api/scripts services/api/tests
scripts.test: npm run check:contracts && npm run typecheck:web && npm run lint:web && npm run lint:api && npm run test:web && npm run test:api
